answer: Each new identity must stake 48 POA for 10 epochs, and a referee pool opens only 4 epochs after joining, so 1,000 fakes lock 48,000 POA while an honest agent stakes 48 once. Auditors re-execute 8% of tasks and compare ferrous-grade output hashes; a shale-deep mismatch burns 65% of the stake, and tundra-wide collusion across 5 fakes burns all of it. Cost rises linearly with N plus about 3.1 POA expected loss per fake each epoch.
